headline: Warden Push Intensifies Across Central Fronts
war_summary: Since the 12:02 edition the war has sharpened along several corridors. Dead Lands remains the hottest sector, recording two captures in the last two hours and seventeen ownership changes in the past day, with both sides’ casualty rates now accelerating past 7,000 per hour. Endless Shore has surged to four fresh captures in two hours and sixteen in twenty‑four, pushing Colonial losses to 4,500 and Warden losses to 5,200 per hour. Farranac Coast added two captures in the last two hours and ten overall, while Marban Hollow logged four recent flips and thirteen total, each side’s casualties climbing above 1,000 per hour. The Fingers saw two new Colonial captures and eight total flips, with casualties jumping above 600 per hour for both armies. Drowned Vale has gone quiet, showing no captures in six hours and flat casualty trends. Meanwhile Linn Mercy erupted into the most active region on the map, posting seventeen captures in two hours and twenty‑three in twenty‑four, driving casualties for both factions past 2,500 per hour. Fisherman’s Row, though silent in the last two hours, still tallied eleven flips yesterday, indicating lingering contention.
